Java Thin Client

1. Dependency
  • <dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.ignite</groupId>
    <artifactId>ignite-core</artifactId>
    <version>2.17.0</version>
</dependency>
2. Connecting
  • ClientConfiguration cfg = new ClientConfiguration()
    .setAddresses("192.168.1.10:10800", "192.168.1.11:10800")
    .setPartitionAwarenessEnabled(true);

try (IgniteClient client = Ignition.startClient(cfg)) {
    // use the client
}
  • Provide multiple addresses for failover — if one node is down, the client connects to another;
3. Key-Value Operations
  • ClientCache<Integer, String> cache = client.getOrCreateCache("myCache");

// Put
cache.put(1, "Alice");

// Get
String value = cache.get(1);

// Remove
cache.remove(1);

// Put all
Map<Integer, String> batch = Map.of(2, "Bob", 3, "Charlie");
cache.putAll(batch);
4. SQL Queries via Thin Client
  • // Execute SQL
SqlFieldsQuery query = new SqlFieldsQuery(
    "SELECT name, age FROM Person WHERE city = ?")
    .setArgs("NYC");

try (QueryCursor<List<?>> cursor = cache.query(query)) {
    for (List<?> row : cursor) {
        System.out.println(row.get(0) + " - " + row.get(1));
    }
}

// DDL
client.query(new SqlFieldsQuery(
    "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS City (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR)")
).getAll();
5. Transactions via Thin Client
  • ClientTransactions txs = client.transactions();

try (ClientTransaction tx = txs.txStart(PESSIMISTIC, REPEATABLE_READ)) {
    ClientCache<Integer, Integer> accounts = client.cache("accounts");
    
    int balance = accounts.get(1);
    accounts.put(1, balance - 100);
    accounts.put(2, accounts.get(2) + 100);
    
    tx.commit();
}
6. Connection Configuration Options
  • ClientConfiguration cfg = new ClientConfiguration()
    .setAddresses("host1:10800", "host2:10800")
    .setPartitionAwarenessEnabled(true)
    .setTimeout(5000)                    // connection timeout
    .setSendBufferSize(64 * 1024)        // TCP send buffer
    .setReceiveBufferSize(64 * 1024)     // TCP receive buffer
    .setRetryLimit(3);                   // retry failed operations
